data: What is the approximate value of the orange circle at 384k oracle requests (Budget B) on the bottom graph?

The bottom graph shows normalized informative scores per answer type, averaged over 10k questions. The orange circle represents the color answer type. At approximately 384k oracle requests (Budget B), the orange circle is located around the 0.3 mark on the y-axis. Therefore, the approximate value of the orange circle at this point is 0.3.
